dedupe_keys.name: world settlement footprint wsf 2015 2019 evolution and 3d

description: The World Settlement Footprint is a family of free and open global datasets from DLR's Earth Observation Center on the extent and form of the built environment. WSF 2015 is a 10 m binary settlement mask from Landsat-8 and Sentinel-1 imagery; WSF 2019 is a 10 m binary mask from multitemporal Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery of 2019; WSF Evolution maps settlement extent yearly from 1985 to 2015 at 30 m from Landsat; and WSF 3D gives average building height, total volume, total area and building fraction at 90 m from TanDEM-X and Sentinel data. The WSF 2019 accuracy was checked in two crowd-sourced validation exercises with Google and MapSwipe, collecting about one million reference labels from very high resolution imagery. Coverage: global. Access: tiled downloads and web map services on the EOC Geoservice, with metadata last updated 3 February 2025. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for WSF 2019; free. Caveats: the masks mark settlement pixels, not individual buildings, and WSF 3D is coarse at 90 m. Simulation uses are global exposure layers for flood, heat and earthquake risk, urban growth analysis and gap filling where building footprints are missing. Related records: the Microsoft and Google building footprint records.
